name: PRISTINE GROVE
description: Located off of Thanisandra main road near Golden Palms behind Purva Atmosphere, Pristine Grove offers 70 premium 2, 2.5, 3 BHK apartments. Best in class amenities including clubhouse, gym, extensive landscaping, children’s play area. Lo
